framework.name: QualiFrame
framework.purpose: Enterprise-oriented test automation for web, API, mobile, desktop, PDF, and mocking with BDD and modular NUnit execution.

repository.layout: Layered src/ projects plus docs/, scripts/, and optional healenium/ Docker Compose for the self-healing backend.

projects.name: QualiFrame.Tests
projects.notes: No package Version attribute; test project is not published.

projects.name: QualiFrame.Runner.Core
projects.notes: Lightweight dotnet test CLI orchestration; Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration only. Debug-only build configuration. No package Version; not published.

projects.name: QualiFrame.Runner
projects.notes: Thin CLI host over Runner.Core; not a test project. Debug-only build configuration. No package Version; not published.

architecture.summary: Shared Framework library, application Tests, PDF engine, Mocking library, and a CLI runner that shells out to dotnet test.
architecture.executionFlow: QualiFrame.Runner -> QualiFrame.Runner.Core -> dotnet test QualiFrame.Tests -> Framework/Pdf/Mocking

layers.name: Framework library
layers.rule: Generic abstractions only; no application-specific page objects.

layers.name: Test implementation
layers.rule: Application page objects, features, steps, hooks, and executable tests.

layers.name: Healenium self-healing
responsibilities: Optional in-repo compose at healenium/; start per DOC-HEALINFRA-001 / DOC-HEAL-001

extensionPoints.name: Page objects
extensionPoints.guidance: Inherit BasePage or ComponentPage; do not add app pages under Framework/PageBases.

extensionPoints.name: Cloud platforms
extensionPoints.guidance: Subclass BaseCloudPlatform and wire via CloudTesting config flags.

extensionPoints.name: Data repositories
extensionPoints.guidance: Implement IDataRepository and extend the factory switch.

boundaries: Do not add application page objects under src/QualiFrame.Framework/PageBases.
Runner must invoke QualiFrame.Tests via dotnet test at runtime, not a project reference.
notes: CalculatorPage under Framework/Desktop/Pages is a sample Windows Calculator page, an exception to the app-PO boundary.

automationApproaches.summary: Hybrid framework: modular NUnit, Reqnroll BDD, file-backed data-driven, keyword-driven Excel scripts, and Screenplay.

items.name: BDD

items.name: Hybrid
items.purpose: Multiple approaches coexist; Mocking adds hybrid UI/API orchestration.

items.name: Screenplay

standards.summary: AI-consumable rules derived from agent-instructions and verified framework usage.

items.name: Layer boundaries
items.rule: Place generic abstractions in QualiFrame.Framework and application pages/features under QualiFrame.Tests.

items.name: Page object location
items.rule: New UI pages belong in src/QualiFrame.Tests/PageObjects and must inherit BasePage or ComponentPage.

items.name: Driver factory
items.rule: Create browsers through EnhancedWebDriverFactory or IWebDriverFactory, not ad-hoc driver construction.

items.name: Synchronization
items.rule: Use framework wait helpers (BasePage waits, IEnhancedElement.WaitForVisible/WaitForClickable, WebDriverWait) instead of arbitrary sleeps.

items.name: Locator placement
items.rule: Keep locators in page/component objects, not in step/test logic.

items.name: Self-healing usage
items.rule: Toggle Healenium via configuration; do not change locator APIs. Do not rely on healing instead of explicit waits.

items.name: Assertions
items.rule: Use NUnit Assert.* as the default; FluentAssertions is available in the test project.

items.name: Reqnroll steps
items.rule: Use [Binding] classes in StepDefinitions with constructor injection (BoDi). Reuse existing step classes before adding duplicates.

items.name: Modular tests
items.rule: Inherit ModularTestCase and implement only SetUp, ExecuteTest, and TearDown. Do not add a competing [Test] on ExecuteTest.

items.name: Test data access
items.rule: Prefer DataRepositoryFactory plus files under Data/ over large embedded payloads.

items.name: Secrets
items.rule: Reference secrets through TestConfiguration/SecretsManager/Key Vault. Never commit real credentials or copy secret values into the manifest.

items.name: Reporting API
items.rule: Prefer UnifiedReportingService when Extent and Allure must stay aligned. Respect AsyncLocal thread isolation.

items.name: Runner isolation
items.rule: Do not add a project reference from Runner to QualiFrame.Tests.

items.name: MTP-safe test invocation
items.rule: Run tests against QualiFrame.Tests.csproj or the TestsOnly solution filter; avoid solution-wide dotnet test when Runner is loaded.

items.name: Desktop OS
items.rule: Desktop scenarios require Windows/FlaUI; use DesktopHooks rather than starting a desktop session ad hoc.

items.name: PDF paths
items.rule: Resolve PDF fixtures via test path helpers; do not hard-code absolute machine paths.

items.name: Driver cleanup
items.rule: Quit/close drivers through factory/hooks/pool cleanup rather than leaking process-level browsers.

items.name: API client reuse
items.rule: Use EnhancedApiClient (REST) or GraphQLClient/QueryBuilder. Do not add a parallel HTTP client.

items.name: Mobile reuse
items.rule: Create Appium sessions through AppiumDriverFactory. Reuse GestureActions, DeviceRotator, KeyboardHandler, MobileContextSwitcher, and AppiumServerManager. Do not construct AndroidDriver/IOSDriver in steps.

items.name: SQL test data
items.rule: SQL is opt-in via DataRepositoryFactory (SQL/SQLSERVER/MSSQL/DATABASE). Excel remains the default. Do not add a second SQL client.

items.name: Logging
items.rule: Use QualiFrame.Framework.Utilities.Logging.Logger. Never log raw secrets; SensitiveDataMasker is applied.

items.name: Retries and exceptions
items.rule: Reuse API Polly retries, IEnhancedElement retry counts, and RetryableException. There is no global NUnit [Retry] policy.

items.name: Video recording
items.rule: Video capture is opt-in via TestConfiguration:VideoRecording. Do not add a second recorder; VideoRecordingManager is wired from EnhancedWebDriverFactory.

items.name: Web core
items.purpose: Driver factory, pool, health, Healenium wrap.

items.name: Page bases and components
items.purpose: POM foundations and reusable UI components.

items.name: API clients
items.purpose: REST client, GraphQL, retry, schema validation.

items.name: Mobile
items.purpose: Appium element and gesture helpers.

items.name: Desktop
items.purpose: FlaUI desktop automation (Microsoft UI Automation).

items.name: Cloud platforms
items.purpose: Remote WebDriver factories for device clouds.

items.name: Data repositories
items.purpose: Excel/CSV/JSON test data access plus opt-in SQL Server.

items.name: Reporting
items.purpose: Extent, Allure, unified facade.
items.notes: ExtentReportManager lives under Reports/, not Reporting/.

items.name: Keyword-driven
items.purpose: Keyword registry and Excel parser.

items.name: Screenplay
items.purpose: Actor/task/question abstractions.

items.name: Core services
items.purpose: ModularTestCase, DI, services, exceptions.

items.name: PDF engine
items.purpose: PdfPig extraction, comparison, plugin validators.

items.name: Mocking
items.purpose: WireMock, OpenAPI stubs, hybrid flows.

items.name: Test implementation
items.purpose: Features, steps, hooks, page objects, examples.

items.name: CLI runner
items.purpose: CommandLineParser host over Runner.Core.

items.name: Runner core
items.purpose: dotnet test orchestration without a Tests project reference.

items.name: Configuration
items.purpose: TestConfiguration and validation.

reusableComponents.summary: Reuse these before creating new helpers.

items.name: EnhancedWebDriverFactory
items.signature: CreateDriver(); GetDriver(); SetCurrentDriver(IWebDriver); GetWebDriverWait(); TakeScreenshot(); QuitDriver(); CloseDriver()
items.usageGuidance: Primary browser lifecycle API. Wrap is applied automatically when Healenium is enabled.

items.name: click
items.usageGuidance: Prefer EnhancedWebElement/BasePage.ClickElement over raw IWebElement.Click in new code.

items.name: type
items.usageGuidance: Also BasePage.SendKeys(By, text) and Screenplay Type task / TypeKeyword.

items.name: waits
items.signature: WaitForVisible/WaitForClickable via IEnhancedElement; BasePage FindElement uses ExpectedConditions
items.usageGuidance: Do not add Thread.Sleep for element sync.

items.name: window/frame/alert helpers
items.usageGuidance: Reuse BasePage window/frame/alert helpers. WebPage.SwitchTabIssue is application-specific demo logic, not a framework API.

items.name: navigate
items.signature: BasePage navigation helpers; Screenplay Tasks.Navigate; NavigateKeyword

items.name: screenshot
items.usageGuidance: Hooks already capture failure screenshots; reuse factory/page helpers.

items.name: HealeniumDriverWrapper
items.usageGuidance: Enable via Healenium:Enabled. Successful finds persist versioned evidence under Healenium:EvidencePath. Healing scores current DOM against historical baselines and accepts a candidate only at/above Healenium:ScoreCap. Official /healenium APIs still receive save/heal/report calls.

items.name: DriverPool
items.usageGuidance: Pool size follows MaxParallelTests.

items.name: RetryPolicy/CircuitBreaker
items.usageGuidance: API retries use Polly; do not add a parallel HTTP retry utility.

items.name: GraphQLClient
items.signature: QueryAsync(query, variables?); MutateAsync(mutation, variables?); SetAuthenticationToken; SetHeader
items.usageGuidance: Endpoint from APITesting:GraphQLEndpoint or constructor argument. Pair with QueryBuilder. See GraphQL.feature.

items.name: GrpcChannelFactory
items.usageGuidance: Opt-in. No proto stubs in-repo; pass your own generated clients the returned channel.

items.name: WebSocketTestClient
items.usageGuidance: Opt-in. Requires APITesting:WebSocket:Url or an explicit URL.

items.name: KafkaMessageClient
items.usageGuidance: Opt-in. Requires Messaging:Kafka:BootstrapServers. Do not add a second Kafka wrapper.

items.name: TelemetryBootstrap
items.usageGuidance: No-op unless Observability:OpenTelemetry:Enabled is true.

items.name: ArtifactStorageClient
items.usageGuidance: Opt-in artifact upload. Never copy connection strings into the manifest.

items.name: AppiumDriverFactory
items.usageGuidance: Primary mobile session API. MobileSteps already uses it.

items.name: MobileContextSwitcher
items.usageGuidance: Use for hybrid WEBVIEW/native switching. Inconclusive when no WEBVIEW exists.

items.name: SyntheticTestDataFactory
items.usageGuidance: Bogus + AutoFixture live in the test project only. Do not add those packages to Framework.

parameters.name: sourceType
parameters.description: EXCEL, CSV, JSON, or SQL/SQLSERVER/MSSQL/DATABASE. Unknown values fall back to Excel.

items.name: SqlDataRepository
items.usageGuidance: Opt-in only. Do not use as the default repository. Requires Environments:QA:DatabaseConnectionString. Table names must be Table or schema.Table identifiers.

items.name: VideoRecordingManager
items.usageGuidance: No-op unless TestConfiguration:VideoRecording is true. Wired from EnhancedWebDriverFactory; do not add a second recorder.

items.name: UnifiedReportingService
items.signature: GetInstance(); StartFeature; StartTestCase; LogStep; CompleteTestCase; AddScreenshot; Flush
items.usageGuidance: BDD hooks use this path. ModularTestCase currently constructs ReportingService with classic AllureReporter.

items.name: ExtentReportManager
items.usageGuidance: Thread-safe Extent facade (AsyncLocal). Prefer UnifiedReportingService when Extent and Allure must stay aligned.

items.name: Logger
items.usageGuidance: Serilog facade with SensitiveDataMasker.

items.name: GestureActions
items.signature: Swipe/SwipeUp/Down/Left/Right; Pinch; Zoom; LongPress; Tap; DoubleTap

items.name: DesktopActions
items.usageGuidance: Also SmartDesktopActions, Dialog/Menu/Grid/Tree/Ribbon helpers.

items.name: DesktopSessionFactory
items.usageGuidance: Call only from DesktopHooks or page/session construction when a desktop scenario runs. Do not start a FlaUI session in BeforeTestRun.

items.name: SecretsManager
items.usageGuidance: AES via Security:EncryptionKey; Azure Key Vault when Security:KeyVault:Url is set. Never log raw secrets.

aiGuidance.summary: How an LLM or MCP agent should consume this repository.
aiGuidance.coreBehavior: Understand -> Validate -> Locate -> Reuse -> Extend -> Verify -> Document
steps: Validate it against FRAMEWORK_MANIFEST.schema.json using python3 scripts/validate-framework-manifest.py.
Identify the requested capability by stable ID.
Identify the automation approach (BDD, modular, keyword, screenplay, hybrid).
Identify the correct module and layer boundary.
Search reusableComponents before creating new helpers.
Check lifecycle and configuration requirements, including secret references.
Follow implementationReferences rather than copying large source into prompts.
Consult documentation IDs listed for the capability.
Generate or modify code in the correct project.
Update this manifest only if framework knowledge changed; do not change the schema unless the knowledge model cannot represent the concept.
aiGuidance.reuseBeforeCreate: Always reuse EnhancedWebDriverFactory, AppiumDriverFactory, BasePage/ComponentPage, DataRepositoryFactory, UnifiedReportingService, ExtentReportManager, EnhancedApiClient, GraphQLClient, GrpcChannelFactory, WebSocketTestClient, KafkaMessageClient, KeywordRegistry, GestureActions, DesktopActions, PdfValidationEngine, VideoRecordingManager, ArtifactStorageClient, and WireMockServerManager when they already cover the need.
doNotAssume: Default-on Kafka/gRPC/WebSocket usage (wrappers are opt-in and need addresses/brokers)
OpenTelemetry runtime pipeline unless Observability:OpenTelemetry:Enabled is true
ALM connectors (qTest/Jira/TestRail) beyond Allure link templates
Hybrid mobile WEBVIEW as a first-class API
aiGuidance.whenToUpdateManifest: Update FRAMEWORK_MANIFEST.json when adding/removing a verified capability, module, reusable component, integration, execution command, or documentation path. Preserve stable IDs; mark removed items deprecated.
aiGuidance.schemaGovernance: Do not modify FRAMEWORK_MANIFEST.schema.json for routine framework knowledge changes. Schema changes require an identified limitation, classification, schemaVersion bump, manifest update, validation, and a note in docs/FRAMEWORK_MANIFEST_GUIDE.md.
